''[[Star Wars: The High Republic: Chronicles of the Jedi]]'' establishes that the [[in-universe]] book {{#ifeq:{{PAGENAME}}|Chronicles of the Jedi|Chronicles of the Jedi|''[[Chronicles of the Jedi]]''}} was written [[Standard week|weeks]] after the [[destruction of Starlight Beacon]], which ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic Character Encyclopedia]]'' dates to [[230 BBY]]. The issuing of the [[Guardian Protocols]], dated by ''The High Republic Character Encyclopedia'' to [[229 BBY]], are depicted in [[The High Republic – Shadows of Starlight 1|''The High Republic – Shadows of Starlight'' 1]] as taking place one week after [[Starlight Beacon]]'s destruction. With this, ''Chronicles of the Jedi'' must have been [[author]]ed no earlier than 229 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]]. ''Chronicles of the Jedi'' further establishes that [[Pra-Tre Veter]] is still a [[Grand Master]] of the [[Jedi Order]], meaning it was written before his [[Pra-Tre Veter's execution|death]], which ''The High Republic Character Encyclopedia'' states took place in 229 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]]. Therefore, ''Chronicles of the Jedi'' must have been written in 229 BBY.<noinclude>
